item.title: NixOS VMs part 5: A NixOS NAS in a Proxmox LXC container
item.description: This is part 5 of a series on nixos-vm-template: Running code agents in an immutable NixOS VM Bootstrapping a Docker server with immutable NixOS on Proxmox Mutable VMs are cool too Managing VMs with home-manager and sway-home A NixOS NAS in a Proxmox LXC container (this post) Every post in this series so far has been about virtual machines - libvirt on a laptop, KVM on Proxmox, immutable or mutable, but always a full guest with its own kernel.
